svg.title: HUD weapon chip — L LASER
svg.desc: Direction B (move the letter read to the HUD): a chip drawn at a FIXED screen size, so the camera pull-back cannot shrink it and the read never depends on 13 pixels of world space. Warm-white top rule, ink plate, the letter and its shape code side by side — the pairing is what would teach the code the world glyphs then use. Judged at 32 and 44 px tall against the HUD's own 15-18px type, not at a world-tile size.
